result.reason: The redline substantially implements the preferred position: it is mutual, agreement-wide, uses the greater-of fee/$1 million cap, excludes indirect and consequential damages, and includes all required uncapped carve-outs. However, the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim, as required by the playbook. Also, the payment carve-out covers only “compensation due under Section 5,” which may be narrower than all Client payment obligations. These are limited but operative deviations from the specified position; otherwise, the changes are targeted and professionally drafted.
